agentSummary:
Inventory is complete. The scan had already recorded some providers. I added four more, all raw HTTP. I did not re-read the files the scan had already covered.

**Added by me (via http):**
- **Raynet CRM** (`app.raynet.cz/api/v2`): looks up, creates and updates companies, and sets ratings and tags.
  - It has 9 call sites in `actions/mail.ts`, `actions/users.tsx` and the Stripe webhook route.
  - Auth is basic auth built from `RAYNET_EMAIL` and `RAYNET_API_KEY`.
- **iDoklad** (`identity.idoklad.cz` and `api.idoklad.cz/v3`): gets an OAuth token, then creates a contact and an invoice. It has 4 call sites in `actions/users.tsx`, all through axios.
- **SmartEmailing** (`app.smartemailing.cz/api/v3`): checks whether a contact exists and imports it into a list. It has 2 call sites in `actions/mail.ts`.
- **Google reCAPTCHA server-side verify** (`www.google.com/recaptcha/api/siteverify`): 1 call site in `actions/captcha.ts`. It sits alongside the existing browser-side usage.

**Already recorded by the scan:** Turso, Stripe (SDK and webhook), Sanity (SDK and HTTP), Upstash Redis, Google Analytics, Calendly, and reCAPTCHA in the browser.

**Leads that are not external APIs:**
- **Email sending:** nodemailer sends through Gmail SMTP, using `FROM_EMAIL` and `FROM_EMAIL_PASSWORD` in `actions/users.tsx`, `actions/mail.ts` and the Stripe webhook route. That is SMTP to an operator-configured server, not an HTTP API, so I didn't record it.
- **Unused dependencies:** `@stripe/stripe-js`, `@supabase/ssr`, `@supabase/supabase-js` (the scan flagged it as imported only in `types/index.d.ts`), `mapbox-gl`, `react-map-gl`, `openai`, `ai`, `twilio` and `sanity-plugin-mux-input` showed no import or call in the code. A grep for openai, twilio, supabase, mapbox and mux returned no matches. I did not open `types/index.d.ts` or `package.json` to confirm.
- **Plain links and embeds:** social profile URLs, a YouTube iframe, `financehb.cz` links and the other hosts in the scan's host list.
- **Own backend:** `app/api/downloadPdf/route.ts` fetches a file URL; the scan already recorded it under Sanity.

**Not checked:**
- I did not read lines 701–861 of `actions/users.tsx`. The grep showed only one more call there, a nodemailer `sendMail` at line 727.
- I did not read lines 120–304 of the Stripe webhook route.
- I did not open the shared-client files the scan flagged with no call found: `lib/utils.ts`, `database/client.ts`, `database/redis.ts`, `sanity/lib/queries.ts` and `sanity/lib/actions.tsx`.
- I did not look in scripts or CI for network calls.
